Twitch.Title: Twitch extension
Twitch.Note: Viewers see the cards left in your deck in the Hearthpulse extension on your channel and can hover a card.
Twitch.SwitchTip: During a game Hearthpulse sends the cards left in your deck to hearthpulse.net, the same as the OBS "Deck" window. The site passes them to the extension on your Twitch channel. Needs a signed-in Hearthpulse account with Twitch linked.
Twitch.DelayTip: If your stream has a delay in OBS, set the same seconds here so the extension's deck does not run ahead of the picture.
Twitch.LinkTip: Opens the Twitch linking page on hearthpulse.net in your browser.
Twitch.Keeps: No hand, no deck order, nothing about the opponent: only the cards left in your deck.
Twitch.Status.SignedOut: Sign in to your Hearthpulse account (Settings → Account): the deck is not sent without it.
Twitch.Status.SignInAgain: Sign in to your account again (Settings → Account): this sign-in lacks the access needed. The deck is not sent until you do.
Twitch.Status.NotLinked: No Twitch account is linked. Link it on the site; Hearthpulse checks again within a minute.
Twitch.Status.NotConfigured: The extension is not set up on the site yet. Sending is stopped; Hearthpulse tries again in a minute.
Twitch.Status.Error: The deck is not being sent: {0}. Hearthpulse tries again in a minute.
Twitch.Error.NotAvailable: the site has no extension yet
